title: Data model for a Biocorner secondary raw material supplier
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a supplier facility or collection point delivering secondary raw materials to Biocorner mortar production, covering its location, contact details, transport mode and distance to the manufacturer.

addressLocality.description: The locality in which the street address is. Model:'https://schema.org/addressLocality'

addressRegion.description: The region in which the locality is. Model:'https://schema.org/addressRegion'

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT code of the unit of measurement of the value.

object.description: URNs of the referenced entities, each with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.
URN of the referenced entity, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:Supplier:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Supplier

name.description: Property. Name of the supplier facility or collection point. May differ from the parent organization name when multiple supply facilities exist.

operatedBy.description: Relationship. Relationship to the Organization entity that operates this supplier facility.

suppliesSRM.description: Relationship. SRM entity types supplied by this facility. Establishes which secondary raw materials originate from this point in the supply chain.

contactPerson.description: Property. Name of the designated contact person responsible for material supply coordination at this facility.

contactEmail.description: Property. Email address of the primary contact person at the supplier facility. Used for supply chain communication and batch tracing inquiries.

address.description: Property. Postal address of the supplier facility as a structured object (street, locality, region, country, postal code), following the schema.org PostalAddress format. addressRegion holds the administrative region where the facility is located, a key parameter for regional circular economy indicators.

transportationMode.description: Property. Primary transport method and vehicle type used for material delivery, including emission standard classification where applicable.

distanceToManufacturer.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Road distance from the supplier facility to the manufacturer. Used for transport emission estimation and regional sourcing analysis.
